prompt:
Build a planar physical multibody crank-rocker four-bar linkage. Place the two grounded revolute pivots 0.25 m apart along the positive x direction. Close the moving loop with a driven crank, a connecting coupler, a 0.20 m output rocker, and four physical revolute joints. Attach a rigid 0.20 m tracer arm at the crank-coupler moving joint, perpendicular to the coupler, and measure the free tracer tip in the ground-frame x-y plane.

Read CrankLength_m and CouplerLength_m from MATLAB base-workspace variables. Support CrankLength_m from 0.10 to 0.15 m and CouplerLength_m from 0.25 to 0.30 m while preserving the non-singular crank-rocker condition CrankLength_m + CouplerLength_m < 0.45 m. The mechanism must obtain its motion through the physical joint chain; do not prescribe the tracer-tip coordinates.

Drive the input crank through one smooth constant-speed revolution from 0 to 360 degrees in 10 seconds. The assembled linkage must remain finite and physically connected, complete the revolution without kinematic breakup, and produce the corresponding closed tracer path for every supported geometry.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named tip_trajectory and drive_state. tip_trajectory contains the measured ground-frame tracer-tip [x, y] position in metres. drive_state contains the measured or physically applied crank [angle, angular speed] in [degrees, degrees/second].

Save the completed model as cand_XMECH08.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMECH08.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
